edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the 'from' address into the core transfer routine.
msg.sender becomes the sender of the public transfer call.
msg.sender is used as the spender when reducing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner argument for approve.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to dev/marketing addresses.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to dev/marketing addresses.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against _owner.
blockBots is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
unblockBot is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
setFee is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
Constructor uses _msgSender() to seed the initial reflection balance and owner.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
Timestamp-provided deadline reaches the router swap call.
Constructor invokes the factory createPair external call.
Constructor writes the deployer address into _owner.
Constructor assigns the entire reflection supply to _rOwned[msg.sender].
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard after clearing/restoring fees.
_transferStandard moves the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH via sendETHToFee after swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the native ETH transfers to dev and marketing.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
setTrading records the current block number in launchBlock.
blockBots writes blacklist entries into the bots mapping.
unblockBot clears a blacklist entry in the bots mapping.
Owner-controlled redis fee values feed multiplication/division arithmetic in fee computation.
setFee writes the tax fee state variable.
setMaxTxnAmount updates the max transaction amount.
setMaxWalletSize updates the max wallet size.
toggleSwap updates the swapEnabled flag.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes the fee-exclusion mapping.
Public transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance updates to _approve.
balanceOf converts reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_transferStandard derives token/reflection amounts through _getValues.
Active redis fee is consumed when computing transfer fee values.
Active tax fee is consumed when computing team fee values.
_maxTxAmount enforces the per-transaction limit inside _transfer.
_maxWalletSize enforces the recipient balance limit inside _transfer.
_swapTokensAtAmount determines the swap trigger threshold inside _transfer.
Blacklist mapping is read to reject bot addresses in _transfer.
tradingOpen gates whether non-owner transfers are permitted.
inSwap flag prevents nested swap execution inside _transfer.
swapEnabled gates automatic swapping inside _transfer.
Fee-exclusion mapping determines whether fees are taken in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair determines buy/sell classification and sniping checks in _transfer.
Router instance is used to approve and execute the swap.
Development address receives half of the ETH fee.
Marketing address receives half of the ETH fee.
launchBlock is compared with block.number to flag sniping buyers.
_transfer writes to the bots blacklist for early snipers.
The external router swap can re-enter _transfer before accounting state is finalized.
Router callback could attempt to re-enter the swap routine; only inSwap partially guards it.
ETH transfer to dev/marketing could re-enter the fee distribution path.
Recipient of ETH fee could re-enter the transfer flow during distribution.
Constructor stores the Uniswap router instance.
Constructor stores the created Uniswap pair address.
Constructor marks owner, contract, dev and marketing as fee-exempt.
lockTheSwap modifier toggles the inSwap lock around the swap.
owner view returns the _owner state variable.
tokenFromReflection validates the amount against _rTotal.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
_reflectFee reduces the _rTotal reflection supply.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with newOwner.
